g:HTMLPanel.p: Show and hide content: Collapse, toggled by a button or from Java.

d:Example.heading: Basic
d:Example.description: A button with `dataToggle="COLLAPSE"` and a `dataTarget` toggles the `Collapse`. A `Collapse` starts open unless `toggle="false"`.

d:Example.heading: Horizontal
d:Example.description: `horizontal` collapses the width instead of the height; give the content a fixed width.

d:Example.heading: From Java
d:Example.description: `show()`, `hide()` and `toggle()` animate the collapse; `addShownHandler` and `addHiddenHandler` run when the animation ends.
